name: Isabel Gomez

resumeText: I am a QA Automation Engineer at Silverline Health where I lead our Selenium and JavaScript test automation framework. I write and maintain browser tests for our patient portal, cover API flows with Newman, and have wired the entire suite into GitLab CI/CD so it runs on every merge request. I report coverage and results in Jira and TestRail, and I have introduced Cypress for faster component-level checks. Before that I was a QA Analyst at Canyon Payroll Systems where I built the foundation of my testing discipline.
